build_mobilenetv3_small_backbone: build a MobileNetV3 small architecture backbone for pose estimation with default batch normalization
build_mobilenetv3_big_backbone: build a MobileNetV3 big architecture backbone with SE blocks and HSwish activations for pose estimation
freeze_mobilenetv3_stages: freeze the first N stages of a MobileNetV3 backbone to prevent gradient updates during training
run_mobilenetv3_forward: run a forward pass through the MobileNetV3 backbone to extract feature maps from input images
review_mobilenetv3_arch_settings: review the MobileNetV3 arch_settings to compare small vs big architecture block configurations
